title: Design System: EduGuard — The Signal Index

hero.purpose: Login story headline on rail ink.

small.purpose: Tabular tables, labels and call numbers; never below 11px for functional text.

label.purpose: Stamped uppercase classification labels; tracking, never a kicker above a heading.

shadows.name: sheet-edge
shadows.purpose: Mobile drawer edge; the only deep shadow.

motion.name: slip-open
motion.purpose: Pull-slip reveal; one authored motion moment.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Vermilion stamp fill with card-white text; the single assertive control.

components.name: Index Card
components.description: A ruled catalogue card: paper ground, hairline frame, classification tab, tabular risk line.
components.css: .alert-card { border: 1px solid #ded9cd; border-radius: 5px; background: #fffdf7; } .alert-risk { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 800; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Classification Tab
components.description: Named disposition hanging from the card's top-right edge; never color alone.
components.css: .card-tab { position: absolute; top: -1px; right: 14px; border: 1px solid #c9c3b3; border-top: 0; border-radius: 0 0 3px 3px; background: #eeece4; font-size: 9px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.9px; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Pull Slip
components.description: Native details/summary holding the evidence behind a pulled signal.
components.html:
Why this card was pulled
Evidence and suggested next step.
components.css: .pull-slip { border-top: 1px dashed #c9c3b3; } .pull-slip summary { color: #8f6a16; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Decision Band
components.description: Sticky paper band with a vermilion tab marker, monumental count and jump action.
components.html: Index07Open the index
components.css: .decision-band { background: #fffdf7; border-bottom: 1px solid #c9c3b3; } .decision-icon { background: #b23a2b; color: #fffdf7; text-transform: uppercase; }

narrative.overview: EduGuard reads as a classified catalogue of advisory student signals on warm stock paper. Charcoal ink, hairline rules and 34px tabular numerals carry the data; one vermilion stamp marks every live decision, with ochre and sage as watch and improving tints. Each signal is an indexed card with a named classification tab and an evidence pull slip; governance is printed on the shell. Standard web controls only — the world contributes type, palette, density and one signature move, never a costume UI.
keyCharacteristics: Warm catalogue stock and card white under charcoal ink, never cool blue slate.
One vermilion stamp for every live decision; ochre and sage stay secondary.
Hairline ruled lines instead of resting shadows.
34px tabular metric numerals and monospace call numbers.
Indexed cards with classification tabs and native evidence disclosures.
Charts use ink lines with a single ochre forecast line against a warm grid.

rules.name: The Stamp Rule
rules.body: Vermilion marks live decisions and focus only; it never becomes a full page field or decorative accent.

rules.name: The Named Tab Rule
rules.body: Every indexed card states its disposition in words on a tab; color is never the sole signal.

rules.name: The Evidence Rule
rules.body: Every pulled card opens a slip explaining the exact evidence and the teacher-owned next step.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Resting surfaces are separated by 1px rules and washes, not shadows.

rules.name: The No-Kicker Rule
rules.body: Headings carry their own weight; no tracked micro-label sits above them.

dos: Do use 12px as the floor for functional text and tabular numerals for aligned values.
Do keep the vermilion focus stamp visible against paper ground with adequate contrast.
Do use the ochre forecast line and ink observed line in charts.
Do keep advisory, teacher-only governance visible in the shell and on evidence slips.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion and keep the pull slip as the only authored motion moment.
donts: Don't introduce kickers, side-tab accents, gradient text, glow shadows or generic icon tiles.
Don't render risk as a verdict or expose AI output in student-facing surfaces.
Don't invent data the model did not use; demo data stays visibly synthetic.
Don't turn the catalogue metaphor into navigation or bespoke controls.
Don't regress to the retired evergreen, airport-yellow or navy palettes.
